authority: POWO/WCVP (direct species pages); ITIS for Solidago juliae historic synonym treatment

records.synonym_note: POWO accepts S. juliae as a distinct species and lists no synonym section; ITIS TSN 505282 treats historical S. canadensis var. canescens A.Gray and S. altissima var. canescens (A.Gray) M.C.Johnst. as synonyms of S. juliae. Do not merge accepted S. canadensis or S. altissima.
records.concept_action: Preserve S. juliae as distinct from S. canadensis and S. altissima; historical variety aliases are author-sensitive.

records.synonym_note: POWO accepts S. bicolor and three infraspecific taxa: subsp. bicolor, nothosubsp. drummondii and subsp. verticilliflorum. Homotypic historical Holcus bicolor L., Holcus sorghum L. and Sorghum vulgare Pers. (illegitimate superfluous) are listed. Source record is species-rank only; do not infer subspecies or hybrid.
records.concept_action: Retain accepted species concept; do not install or rename learner cards in taxonomy lane.
